crossrefs.text: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding has no limit.
O, the depth of the riches of the wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are His judgments, and untraceable His ways!
the One who does great and unsearchable things, wonders without number.
Do you not know? Have you not heard? The LORD is the everlasting God, the Creator of the ends of the earth. He will not grow tired or weary; His understanding is beyond searching out.
Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises!
God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.
He does great things beyond searching out, and wonders without number.
Your throne, O God, endures forever and ever, and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom.
Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.
that we have heard and known and our fathers have relayed to us.
that they should put their confidence in God, not forgetting His works, but keeping His commandments.

I will make known the LORDʼs loving devotion and His praiseworthy acts, because of all that the LORD has done for us— the many good things for the house of Israel according to His great compassion and loving devotion.
And you shall teach them diligently to your children and speak of them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
and on that day you will say: “Give praise to the LORD; proclaim His name! Make His works known among the peoples; declare that His name is exalted.
The living, only the living, can thank You, as I do today; fathers will tell their children about Your faithfulness.
Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.

‘The LORD is slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion, forgiving iniquity and transgression. Yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished; He will visit the iniquity of the fathers upon their children to the third and fourth generation.’
The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
The LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of distress; He cares for those who trust in Him.
For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of His hands.
For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.
Then you will call upon Me and come and pray to Me, and I will listen to you.
You will seek Me and find Me when you search for Me with all your heart.
The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
I ask that out of the riches of His glory He may strengthen you with power through His Spirit in your inner being,
Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine, according to His power that is at work within us,
For what nation is great enough to have a god as near to them as the LORD our God is to us whenever we call on Him?
God is Spirit, and His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.”
